contents.description: buka URI in browser if server under debugging is ready.
contents.debug.server.ready.serverReadyAction.des: Act upon a URI when a server program under debugging is ready (indicated oleh sending keluaran of the form 'listening on port 3000' atau 'Now listening on: https://localhost:5001' to the konsol debug.)
contents.debug.server.ready.action.description: What to do dengan the URI when the server is ready.
contents.debug.server.ready.action.openExternally: buka URI externally dengan the bawaan application.
contents.debug.server.ready.action.openIntegrated: buka URI in the integrated browser.
contents.debug.server.ready.action.debugWithChrom: mulai debugging dengan the 'Debugger untuk Chrome'.
contents.debug.server.ready.pattern.description: Server is ready if this pattern appears on the konsol debug. The first capture grup must include a URI atau a port number.
contents.debug.server.ready.uriFormat.description: A format string used when constructing the URI dari a port number. The first '%s' is substituted dengan the port number.
contents.debug.server.ready.webRoot.description: Value passed to the debug configuration untuk the 'Debugger untuk Chrome'.
contents.debug.server.ready.killOnServerStop.desc: hentikan the child sesi when the parent sesi dihentikan.
contents.debug.server.ready.debugConfigName.descr: Name of the launch configuration to jalankan.
